verses.original: Ὁμοίως αἱ γυναῖκες ὑποτασσόμεναι τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν ἵνα καὶ εἴ τινες ἀπειθοῦσιν τῷ λόγῳ διὰ τῆς τῶν γυναικῶν ἀναστροφῆς ἄνευ λόγου κερδηθήσονται
verses.transliteration: Homoiōs hai gynaikes hypotassomenai tois idiois andrasin hina kai ei tines apeithousin tō logō dia tēs tōn gynaikōn anastrophēs aneu logou kerdēthēsontai
verses.literal: Wives in the same way submit yourselves to your husbands so that even if they refuse to believe the word they will be won over without words by the behavior of their wives

verses.original: ἐποπτεύσαντες τὴν ἐν φόβῳ ἁγνὴν ἀναστροφὴν ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: epopteusantes tēn en phobō hagnēn anastrophēn hymōn
verses.literal: when they see your pure and reverent demeanor

verses.original: ὧν ἔστω οὐχ ὁ ἔξωθεν ἐμπλοκῆς τριχῶν καὶ περιθέσεως χρυσίων ἢ ἐνδύσεως ἱματίων κόσμος
verses.transliteration: hōn estō ouch ho exōthen emplokēs trichōn kai peritheseōs chrysiōn ē endyseōs himatiōn kosmos
verses.literal: Your beauty should not come from outward adornment such as braided hair or gold jewelry or fine clothes

verses.original: ἀλλ’ ὁ κρυπτὸς τῆς καρδίας ἄνθρωπος ἐν τῷ ἀφθάρτῳ τοῦ πραέως καὶ ἡσυχίου πνεύματος ὅ ἐστιν ἐνώπιον τοῦ Θεοῦ πολυτελές
verses.transliteration: all’ ho kryptos tēs kardias anthrōpos en tō aphthartō tou praeōs kai hēsychiou pneumatos ho estin enōpion tou Theou polyteles
verses.literal: but from the inner disposition of your heart the unfading beauty of a gentle and quiet spirit which is precious in God’s sight

verses.original: Οὕτως γάρ ποτε καὶ αἱ ἅγιαι γυναῖκες αἱ ἐλπίζουσαι εἰς Θεὸν ἐκόσμουν ἑαυτάς ὑποτασσόμεναι τοῖς ἰδίοις ἀνδράσιν
verses.transliteration: Houtōs gar pote kai hai hagiai gynaikes hai elpizousai eis Theon ekosmoun heautas hypotassomenai tois idiois andrasin
verses.literal: For this is how the holy women of the past adorned themselves They put their hope in God and were submissive to their husbands

verses.original: ὡς Σάρρα ὑπήκουσεν τῷ Ἀβραάμ κύριον αὐτὸν καλοῦσα ἧς ἐγενήθητε τέκνα ἀγαθοποιοῦσαι καὶ μὴ φοβούμεναι μηδεμίαν πτόησιν
verses.transliteration: hōs Sarra hypēkousen tō Abraam kyrion auton kalousa hēs egenēthēte tekna agathopoiousai kai mē phoboumenai mēdemian ptoēsin
verses.literal: just as Sarah obeyed Abraham and called him lord And you are her children if you do what is right and refuse to give way . . . to fear

verses.original: Οἱ ἄνδρες ὁμοίως συνοικοῦντες κατὰ γνῶσιν ὡς ἀσθενεστέρῳ σκεύει τῷ γυναικείῳ ἀπονέμοντες τιμήν ὡς καὶ συνκληρονόμοις χάριτος ζωῆς εἰς τὸ μὴ ἐνκόπτεσθαι τὰς προσευχὰς ὑμῶν
verses.transliteration: Hoi andres homoiōs synoikountes kata gnōsin hōs asthenesterō skeuei tō gynaikeiō aponemontes timēn hōs kai synklēronomois charitos zōēs eis to mē enkoptesthai tas proseuchas hymōn
verses.literal: Husbands in the same way treat . . . your wives with consideration as a delicate vessel and with honor as fellow heirs of the gracious gift of life so that your prayers will not be hindered

verses.original: Τὸ δὲ τέλος πάντες ὁμόφρονες συμπαθεῖς φιλάδελφοι εὔσπλαγχνοι ταπεινόφρονες
verses.transliteration: To de telos pantes homophrones sympatheis philadelphoi eusplanchnoi tapeinophrones
verses.literal: Finally all of you be like-minded and sympathetic love as brothers be tenderhearted and humble

verses.original: μὴ ἀποδιδόντες κακὸν ἀντὶ κακοῦ ἢ λοιδορίαν ἀντὶ λοιδορίας τοὐναντίον δὲ εὐλογοῦντες ὅτι εἰς τοῦτο ἐκλήθητε ἵνα εὐλογίαν κληρονομήσητε
verses.transliteration: mē apodidontes kakon anti kakou ē loidorian anti loidorias tounantion de eulogountes hoti eis touto eklēthēte hina eulogian klēronomēsēte
verses.literal: Do not repay evil with evil or insult with insult but . . . with blessing because to this you were called so that you may inherit a blessing

verses.original: Ὁ γὰρ θέλων ζωὴν ἀγαπᾶν καὶ ἰδεῖν ἡμέρας ἀγαθὰς παυσάτω τὴν γλῶσσαν ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ χείλη τοῦ μὴ λαλῆσαι δόλον
verses.transliteration: Ho gar thelōn zōēn agapan kai idein hēmeras agathas pausatō tēn glōssan apo kakou kai cheilē tou mē lalēsai dolon
verses.literal: For Whoever would love life and see good days must keep his tongue from evil and his lips from deceitful speech

verses.original: ἐκκλινάτω δὲ ἀπὸ κακοῦ καὶ ποιησάτω ἀγαθόν ζητησάτω εἰρήνην καὶ διωξάτω αὐτήν
verses.transliteration: ekklinatō de apo kakou kai poiēsatō agathon zētēsatō eirēnēn kai diōxatō autēn
verses.literal: He must turn from evil and do good he must seek peace and pursue it

verses.original: ὅτι ὀφθαλμοὶ Κυρίου ἐπὶ δικαίους καὶ ὦτα αὐτοῦ εἰς δέησιν αὐτῶν πρόσωπον δὲ Κυρίου ἐπὶ ποιοῦντας κακά
verses.transliteration: hoti ophthalmoi Kyriou epi dikaious kai ōta autou eis deēsin autōn prosōpon de Kyriou epi poiountas kaka
verses.literal: For the eyes of the Lord are on the righteous and His ears are inclined to their prayer But the face of the Lord is against those who do evil

verses.original: Καὶ τίς ὁ κακώσων ὑμᾶς ἐὰν τοῦ ἀγαθοῦ ζηλωταὶ γένησθε
verses.transliteration: Kai tis ho kakōsōn hymas ean tou agathou zēlōtai genēsthe
verses.literal: Who can harm you if you are zealous for what is good

verses.original: Ἀλλ’ εἰ καὶ πάσχοιτε διὰ δικαιοσύνην μακάριοι Τὸν δὲ φόβον αὐτῶν μὴ φοβηθῆτε μηδὲ ταραχθῆτε
verses.transliteration: All’ ei kai paschoite dia dikaiosynēn makarioi Ton de phobon autōn mē phobēthēte mēde tarachthēte
verses.literal: But even if you should suffer for what is right you are blessed Do not fear what they fear do not be shaken

verses.original: Κύριον δὲ τὸν Χριστὸν ἁγιάσατε ἐν ταῖς καρδίαις ὑμῶν ἕτοιμοι ἀεὶ πρὸς ἀπολογίαν παντὶ τῷ αἰτοῦντι ὑμᾶς λόγον περὶ τῆς ἐν ὑμῖν ἐλπίδος ἀλλὰ μετὰ πραΰτητος καὶ φόβου
verses.transliteration: Kyrion de ton Christon hagiasate en tais kardiais hymōn hetoimoi aei pros apologian panti tō aitounti hymas logon peri tēs en hymin elpidos alla meta prautētos kai phobou
verses.literal: But in your hearts sanctify Christ as Lord Always be prepared to give a defense to everyone who asks you the reason for the hope that is in you But respond with gentleness and respect

verses.original: συνείδησιν ἔχοντες ἀγαθήν ἵνα ἐν ᾧ καταλαλεῖσθε καταισχυνθῶσιν οἱ ἐπηρεάζοντες ὑμῶν τὴν ἀγαθὴν ἐν Χριστῷ ἀναστροφήν
verses.transliteration: syneidēsin echontes agathēn hina en hō katalaleisthe kataischynthōsin hoi epēreazontes hymōn tēn agathēn en Christō anastrophēn
verses.literal: keeping a clear conscience so that those who slander you . . . . . . may be put to shame by your good behavior in Christ

verses.original: κρεῖττον γὰρ ἀγαθοποιοῦντας εἰ θέλοι τὸ θέλημα τοῦ Θεοῦ πάσχειν ἢ κακοποιοῦντας
verses.transliteration: kreitton gar agathopoiountas ei theloi to thelēma tou Theou paschein ē kakopoiountas
verses.literal: For it is better if it is God’s will to suffer for doing good than for doing evil

verses.original: ὅτι καὶ Χριστὸς ἅπαξ περὶ ἁμαρτιῶν ἔπαθεν δίκαιος ὑπὲρ ἀδίκων ἵνα ὑμᾶς προσαγάγῃ τῷ Θεῷ θανατωθεὶς μὲν σαρκὶ ζωοποιηθεὶς δὲ πνεύματι
verses.transliteration: hoti kai Christos hapax peri hamartiōn epathen dikaios hyper adikōn hina hymas prosagagē tō Theō thanatōtheis men sarki zōopoiētheis de pneumati
verses.literal: For Christ also suffered for sins once for all the righteous for the unrighteous to bring you to God He was put to death in the body but made alive in the Spirit

verses.original: ἐν ᾧ καὶ τοῖς ἐν φυλακῇ πνεύμασιν πορευθεὶς ἐκήρυξεν
verses.transliteration: en hō kai tois en phylakē pneumasin poreutheis ekēryxen
verses.literal: in whom He also went and preached to the spirits in prison

verses.original: ἀπειθήσασίν ποτε ὅτε ἀπεξεδέχετο ἡ τοῦ Θεοῦ μακροθυμία ἐν ἡμέραις Νῶε κατασκευαζομένης κιβωτοῦ εἰς ἣν ὀλίγοι τοῦτ’ ἔστιν ὀκτὼ ψυχαί διεσώθησαν δι’ ὕδατος
verses.transliteration: apeithēsasin pote hote apexedecheto hē tou Theou makrothymia en hēmerais Nōe kataskeuazomenēs kibōtou eis hēn oligoi tout’ estin oktō psychai diesōthēsan di’ hydatos
verses.literal: who disobeyed long ago when God waited patiently in the days of Noah while the ark was being built In the ark a few people only . . . eight souls were saved through water

verses.original: ὃ καὶ ὑμᾶς ἀντίτυπον νῦν σῴζει βάπτισμα οὐ σαρκὸς ἀπόθεσις ῥύπου ἀλλὰ συνειδήσεως ἀγαθῆς ἐπερώτημα εἰς Θεόν δι’ ἀναστάσεως Ἰησοῦ Χριστοῦ
verses.transliteration: ho kai hymas antitypon nyn sōzei baptisma ou sarkos apothesis rhypou alla syneidēseōs agathēs eperōtēma eis Theon di’ anastaseōs Iēsou Christou
verses.literal: And this water symbolizes the baptism that now saves you also not the removal of dirt from the body but the pledge of a clear conscience toward God through the resurrection of Jesus Christ

verses.original: ὅς ἐστιν ἐν δεξιᾷ τοῦ Θεοῦ πορευθεὶς εἰς οὐρανόν ὑποταγέντων αὐτῷ ἀγγέλων καὶ ἐξουσιῶν καὶ δυνάμεων
verses.transliteration: hos estin en dexia tou Theou poreutheis eis ouranon hypotagentōn autō angelōn kai exousiōn kai dynameōn
verses.literal: who has gone into heaven and is at the right hand of God with angels authorities and powers subject to Him
